snip.t: For children 6–59 months, MUAC below 115 mm indicates severe acute malnutrition; 115 to below 125 mm indicates moderate acute malnutrition in standard WHO community/clinical criteria.
MUAC below 11.5 cm indicates severe acute malnutrition; 11.5 to less than 12.5 cm indicates moderate acute malnutrition.
